note: Contract shared by tools/texgen/bld_terrace.py (paints) and tools/blender/bld_terrace.py (model). env_bld_terrace_{poor,normal}: a 100 x 20 attached-townhouse row, 15 u eaves (three 5 u storeys, like the existing facades), pitched roof ridge along X (+4 u). Facade faces Blender -Y (game +Z, the Street camera). The game has one ambient light and ignores vertex colour, so every texture paints its own form: sill and lintel shadows, recess darkening, a cornice shadow band, a darker plinth. Rects are [x, y, w, h] from the image's top-left (v = 1 - y / h). Poor = same layout, darker/greyer, grime streaks, boarded and broken windows, peeled plaster, missing shutters. No texture tiles in UV space (StreetView does not set wrap: >1 UVs clamp once a texture is IDE-listed), so the facade spans the full 100 u once, the roof is mapped once per slope, and the brick once per end wall.

bld_terrace_facade.tiles: none: spans the full 100 u once (10 houses of 32 px / 10 u), V = full 15 u wall height incl. cornice

bld_terrace_brick.tiles: none: mapped once per end wall (20 x 19 u) and over chimney faces
bld_terrace_brick.look: End walls, gable triangles and chimneys: running-bond red-brown brick, light grime at the base of the tile, soot at the top.

bld_terrace_roof.tiles: none: mapped once per roof slope (100 x ~10.8 u)
bld_terrace_roof.look: Terracotta/brown-red pantiles in staggered rows with shadow under each course; poor: faded, mossy and with missing tiles.

bld_terrace_trim.look: Cornice top and soffit, canopy tops, steps, chimney caps: pale weathered stone/concrete.
